name: Pythagorean Theorem
subject: Math
description: Fundamental relationship among the three sides of a right triangle.

name: Circle Area & Circumference
subject: Math
plainText: A = π * r², C = 2 * π * r
description: Formulas for the 2D area and perimeter circumference of a circular disk of radius r.

name: Sphere Volume & Surface Area
subject: Math
description: Calculates the total 3D enclosed volume and exterior surface area of a solid sphere.

name: Quadratic Formula & Discriminant
subject: Math
description: Calculates real or complex roots of any second-degree polynomial equation ax² + bx + c = 0.

name: Logarithm Laws & Change of Base
subject: Math
latex: $$\log_b(xy) = \log_b x + \log_b y, \quad \log_b\left(\frac{x}{y}\right) = \log_b x - \log_b y, \quad \log_b x = \frac{\ln x}{\ln b}$$
plainText: log(xy) = log(x) + log(y), log(x/y) = log(x) - log(y), log_b(x) = ln(x)/ln(b)
description: Essential algebraic identities governing logarithmic multiplication, division, powers, and base transitions.

name: Binomial Theorem
subject: Math
description: Algebraic expansion of powers of a binomial sum into polynomial series coefficients.

name: Pythagorean Trigonometric Identities
subject: Math
description: Fundamental trigonometric identities derived from the unit circle geometry.

name: Double Angle & Angle Addition Formulas
subject: Math
description: Trigonometric expansion of doubled angular arguments into single angular factors.

name: Law of Sines & Law of Cosines
subject: Math
latex: $$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C}, \quad c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C$$
plainText: a/sin(A) = b/sin(B) = c/sin(C), c² = a² + b² - 2ab*cos(C)
description: Solves for unknown side lengths and interior angles of arbitrary non-right triangles.

name: Derivative Power Rule
subject: Math
description: Fundamental derivative rule for differentiating algebraic polynomial terms of power n.

name: Product & Quotient Rules
subject: Math
latex: $$\frac{d}{dx}[uv] = u v' + v u', \quad \frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{u}{v}\right] = \frac{u' v - u v'}{v^2}$$
plainText: d/dx [u*v] = u*v' + v*u', d/dx [u/v] = (u'*v - u*v') / v²
description: Differentiation formulas for products and rational quotients of differentiable functions.

name: Chain Rule (Composite Functions)
subject: Math
description: Calculates the derivative of composite functional dependencies.

name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
subject: Math
latex: $$\int_{a}^{b} f(x) \, dx = F(b) - F(a), \quad \frac{d}{dx} \left[ \int_{a}^{x} f(t) \, dt \right] = f(x)$$
plainText: ∫[a to b] f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a)
description: Bridges differentiation and definite integration through the evaluation of antiderivatives F(x).

name: Integration by Parts
subject: Math
latex: $$\int u \, dv = u v - \int v \, du$$
description: Integration technique that transforms the integral of a product of functions into a simpler integral.

name: Taylor & Maclaurin Series Expansion
subject: Math
description: Infinite polynomial series approximation of a smooth, infinitely differentiable function at expansion center a.

name: Euler's Formula & Identity
subject: Math
description: Profound equation uniting complex exponential growth with trigonometric rotation in the complex plane.

name: Vector Dot Product & Cross Product
subject: Math
description: Calculates scalar projection magnitude and orthogonal normal vector area in 3D Euclidean space.

name: Matrix Eigenvalues & Characteristic Equation
subject: Math
plainText: A * v = λ * v, det(A - λI) = 0
description: Calculates invariant directional eigenvectors v and scalar scaling factors λ under linear operator matrix A.

name: Continuous Fourier Transform
subject: Math
latex: $$\hat{f}(\xi) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x) e^{-2\pi i x \xi} \, dx, \quad f(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \hat{f}(\xi) e^{2\pi i x \xi} \, d\xi$$
description: Decomposes continuous time-domain or spatial functions into continuous frequency spectral components.

name: Speed, Velocity & Average Motion
subject: Physics
plainText: v = d / t, a = (v - u) / t
description: Definitions of average speed, linear velocity, and uniform acceleration.

name: Mass Density Formula
subject: Physics
description: Calculates volumetric mass density of a homogeneous solid, liquid, or gas.

name: SUVAT: Velocity-Time Equation
subject: Physics
description: Calculates final velocity with constant linear acceleration a over elapsed time t.

name: SUVAT: Displacement-Time Equation
subject: Physics
description: Calculates total displacement covered under constant linear acceleration over time t.

name: SUVAT: Timeless Velocity-Displacement
subject: Physics
description: Relates final velocity to initial velocity, acceleration, and displacement independently of time.

name: Newton's Second Law of Motion
subject: Physics
description: Net external force on a body equals the product of its inertial mass and resulting acceleration.

name: Linear Momentum & Impulse
subject: Physics
plainText: p = m * v, J = F * Δt = Δp
description: Translational linear momentum of mass m and change in momentum produced by applied impulse force J.

name: Work, Kinetic Energy & Mechanical Power
subject: Physics
plainText: W = F * d * cos(θ), E_k = 0.5 * m * v², P = W / t
description: Defines mechanical work done by force F, translational kinetic energy, and instantaneous power delivery.

name: Gravitational Potential Energy & Gravity Law
subject: Physics
latex: $$E_p = mgh, \quad F_g = G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}, \quad U_g = -G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r}$$
plainText: E_p = m * g * h, F_g = G * (m1*m2) / r²
description: Calculates local near-surface potential energy mgh and universal gravitational attraction force between point masses.

name: Uniform Circular Motion & Centripetal Force
subject: Physics
latex: $$a_c = \frac{v^2}{r} = \omega^2 r, \quad F_c = m a_c = \frac{m v^2}{r}, \quad \omega = \frac{2\pi}{T} = 2\pi f$$
plainText: a_c = v² / r = ω² * r, F_c = m * v² / r
description: Radial acceleration and inward centripetal force required to sustain circular motion at tangential velocity v.

name: Hooke's Law & Simple Harmonic Motion (SHM)
subject: Physics
description: Restoring force in linear elastic springs and oscillation periods of mass-spring systems and simple pendulums.

name: Specific Heat Capacity & Calorimetry
subject: Physics
latex: $$Q = m c \Delta T, \quad Q_{\text{latent}} = m L$$
plainText: Q = m * c * ΔT, Q = m * L
description: Thermal energy required to raise temperature of mass m by ΔT or change phase via latent heat L.

name: First Law of Thermodynamics
subject: Physics
latex: $$\Delta U = Q - W, \quad W = \int P \, dV$$
description: Conservation of energy in closed thermodynamic systems: change in internal energy equals added heat minus work done by the system.

name: Wave Speed & Snell's Law of Refraction
subject: Physics
plainText: v = f * λ, n1 * sin(θ1) = n2 * sin(θ2), n = c / v
description: Wave propagation speed and angular refraction of light crossing the boundary between two optical media of indices n1 and n2.

name: Thin Lens & Mirror Equation
subject: Physics
description: Calculates focal length, object/image distance, and linear magnification for optical lenses and curved spherical mirrors.

name: Doppler Effect (Sound & Light Waves)
subject: Physics
description: Observed frequency shift of acoustic or electromagnetic waves resulting from relative motion between source and observer.

name: Ohm's Law & Circuit Resistivity
subject: Physics
latex: $$V = I R, \quad R = \rho \frac{L}{A}, \quad P = V I = I^2 R = \frac{V^2}{R}$$
plainText: V = I * R, R = ρ * L / A, P = V * I = I² * R
description: Fundamental relationship between voltage V, current I, resistance R, conductor geometry (L, A), and power P.

name: Coulomb's Electrostatic Force Law
subject: Physics
description: Electrostatic attractive or repulsive force between two stationary electric point charges separated by distance r.

name: Faraday's Law of Electromagnetic Induction
subject: Physics
plainText: EMF = -N * dΦ/dt, Φ = B * A * cos(θ)
description: Induced electromotive force (EMF) in a coil is proportional to the negative rate of change of magnetic flux Φ_B through the circuit.

name: Maxwell's Equations of Electrodynamics
subject: Physics
description: Complete differential framework describing electromagnetic wave propagation, charges, currents, and fields.

name: Photoelectric Effect & Photon Energy
subject: Physics
latex: $$E = h f = \frac{h c}{\lambda}, \quad E_{k,\text{max}} = h f - \Phi = q V_{\text{stop}}$$
plainText: E = h * f = hc / λ, E_k = h*f - Φ
description: Einstein's quantization of light into photons of energy hf and maximum kinetic energy of emitted photoelectrons.

variables.\\Phi: work function of metal (J or eV)

name: Mass-Energy Equivalence & Radioactive Decay
subject: Physics
latex: $$E = m c^2, \quad N(t) = N_0 e^{-\lambda t}, \quad t_{1/2} = \frac{\ln 2}{\lambda} \approx \frac{0.693}{\lambda}$$
plainText: E = m * c², N(t) = N0 * e^(-λ*t), t_half = ln(2) / λ
description: Einstein's mass-energy conversion formula and first-order exponential decay kinetics of radioactive nuclides.

name: Ideal Gas Law & Combined Gas Law
subject: Chemistry
latex: $$P V = n R T = N k_B T, \quad \frac{P_1 V_1}{T_1} = \frac{P_2 V_2}{T_2}$$
description: Equation of state relating pressure, volume, temperature, and moles of an ideal gas.

name: Molarity, Mole Concept & Dilution
subject: Chemistry
plainText: M = n / V, n = mass / MolarMass, M1*V1 = M2*V2
description: Calculates solution molarity, molar amounts from mass, and volumetric chemical dilution ratios.

name: Gibbs Free Energy & Reaction Spontaneity
subject: Chemistry
latex: $$\Delta G^\circ = \Delta H^\circ - T \Delta S^\circ = -R T \ln K_{\text{eq}} = -n F E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$$
description: Thermodynamic criterion for chemical spontaneity (ΔG < 0), equilibrium constants, and cell potentials.

name: Arrhenius Equation (Reaction Rate Kinetics)
subject: Chemistry
description: Quantifies the exponential temperature dependence of reaction rate constants and activation energy barrier E_a.

name: Henderson-Hasselbalch Buffer Equation
subject: Chemistry
description: Calculates the pH of a conjugate acid-base buffer solution based on acid dissociation constant pKa and molar ratio.

name: Nernst Equation (Electrochemical Potential)
subject: Chemistry
latex: $$E = E^\circ - \frac{R T}{z F} \ln Q = E^\circ - \frac{0.0592}{z} \log_{10} Q \; (\text{at } 298\text{K})$$
description: Calculates non-standard reduction potential of electrochemical cells as a function of temperature and reaction quotient Q.

name: Binary Search Algorithm Complexity
subject: Computer Science
description: Logarithmic search on sorted arrays by repeatedly halving search intervals.

name: Sorting Algorithms Complexity Matrix
subject: Computer Science
plainText: MergeSort: O(n log n), QuickSort: O(n log n) avg, BubbleSort: O(n²)
description: Comparative time and space bounds for comparison-based array sorting algorithms.

name: Data Structures Operation Complexities
subject: Computer Science
latex: $$\text{Hash Table: } \mathcal{O}(1) \text{ Access/Insert}, \quad \text{BST: } \mathcal{O}(\log n) \text{ avg}, \quad \text{Array: } \mathcal{O}(1) \text{ Lookup}, \; \mathcal{O}(n) \text{ Insert}$$
plainText: Hash Table: O(1) avg, BST: O(log n) avg, Array: O(1) index lookup
description: Time bounds for standard access, search, insertion, and deletion operations across fundamental data structures.

name: Dijkstra's Shortest Path Algorithm
subject: Computer Science
latex: $$\mathcal{O}((V + E) \log V) \text{ Time with Min-Heap Priority Queue}, \quad \mathcal{O}(V) \text{ Space}$$
plainText: Time: O((V + E) log V), Space: O(V)
description: Finds the single-source shortest path spanning distances in non-negative edge weighted graphs.

name: Master Theorem for Recurrence Relations
subject: Computer Science
latex: $$T(n) = a T\left(\frac{n}{b}\right) + f(n) \implies T(n) = \Theta(n^{\log_b a}) \text{ or } \Theta(n^c \log^k n)$$
description: Provides closed-form asymptotic big-Theta bounds for divide-and-conquer recurrence relations.

name: Dynamic Programming Recurrence & Memoization
subject: Computer Science
description: Solves complex optimization problems by breaking them into overlapping subproblems with optimal substructure.

name: Speed of Light in Vacuum (c)
subject: Constants
description: Exact universal physical speed limit of all electromagnetic radiation and massless fields in vacuum.

name: Planck Constant (h & ħ)
subject: Constants
description: Fundamental quantum of action relating photon energy to oscillation frequency (E = hf = ħω).

name: Newtonian Constant of Gravitation (G)
subject: Constants
description: Empirical physical constant involved in calculation of gravitational attraction forces.

name: Boltzmann Constant (k_B)
subject: Constants
description: Relates average relative thermal kinetic energy of microscopic particles in a gas with macroscopic temperature.

name: Elementary Charge (e)
subject: Constants
description: Exact electric charge carried by a single proton or negative charge magnitude of an electron.

name: Avogadro Constant (N_A)
subject: Constants
description: Number of constituent elementary particles (atoms or molecules) contained in exactly one mole.

name: Molar Gas Constant (R)
subject: Constants
description: Fundamental physical constant in ideal gas thermodynamics equal to the product of Avogadro's constant and Boltzmann's constant.

name: Permittivity & Permeability of Free Space (ε_0 & μ_0)
subject: Constants
description: Constitutive vacuum permittivity and permeability constants connecting electrostatics and magnetostatics with the speed of light.
